node.statement: The constants in 1.1 are positive/finite and universal because the witnesses in lem-maincb-improvement-one-step are universal. For epsilon>0, nodes 1.2-1.3 provide the required finite correction output, floor, amplification identity, and displacement. For epsilon=0, nodes 1.4-1.5 provide their operator-norm limit with the same amplification identity, displacement bound, dagger preservation, and zero floor. These two exhaustive cases prove the root contract with e_it, K_disp, and K_floor chosen in 1.1.
